description: A tall plastic tennis-ball canister with a red lid sits on the table in front of the hands. The left hand reaches to grasp the canister while the right hand steadies it, then the right hand lifts off the red lid and both hands tilt the canister so tennis balls slide out; the right hand picks up and guides a ball near the opening and the hands continue removing balls until several are on the tabletop, after which the right hand presses the red lid back onto the canister and the left hand sets it upright.
